records.subject: Modulation of hydrophilic PDAC–hydrophobic EMIM:TFSI interactions
records.quote: By precisely modulating the interactions between the in situ polymerizable hydrophilic matrix (PDAC) (Poly([2-(Acryloyloxy)ethyl]dimethylammonium chloride)) and the hydrophobic ionic liquid (EMIM:TFSI) (1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide), spontaneous formation of bicontinuous microstructures is achieved that simultaneously deliver record-high thermopower (30.80 mV K-1), exceptional mechanical properties (762% strain, 2862.51 kJ m-3 toughness), and self-healing efficiency (85% thermal voltage retention).
